concept: Managed Service for Apache Flink: real-time stream analytics
tests: Choosing a service for continuous stateful stream processing (windowed aggregates, anomalies) with SQL/Flink.
expected: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink (formerly Kinesis Data Analytics). Triggers: "continuous real-time aggregations", "sliding window", "anomaly detection", "SQL or Apache Flink" on a Kinesis stream.
why_not: Athena queries data at rest in S3; Firehose only delivers/buffers without stateful analytics; Glue ETL is batch Spark.
